expected_behavior: The first pointerMove after pointerDown must commit to drawing/rejecting based on the classifier's MOST CURRENT reading at that moment (state.lastClassification), not the reading captured at pointerDown. Once promoted, the decision must not be re-evaluated on later classifierUpdate calls -- only the pre-promotion window is in scope.
allowed_repairs: in pointerMove's promotion branch, use state.lastClassification instead of the classifiedAsAtStart value captured at pointerDown
any equivalent fix that reads the current classification at the moment of promotion rather than the pointerDown-time snapshot
forbidden_repairs: continuously re-evaluating classification after promotion (letting a late classifierUpdate flip an already-committed decision) -- caught by once_promoted_later_classifier_updates_do_not_flip_decision
removing the palm-rejection classifier check entirely (always drawing, or always rejecting)
changing pointerDown to require an already-correct classification up front instead of fixing the promotion-time read
